blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large language model (LLM)-based agents can exhibit deceptive behavior during task execution, including hiding failures, fabricating results, or falsely signaling task completion. Existing monitoring approaches mainly detect deception after it appears in observable actions or outputs. In this paper, we investigate whether deceptive behavior can be predicted from an agent’s internal representations before it becomes externally visible. We frame deception monitoring as a trajectory-level representation analysis problem and align agent trajectories around key decision points. Using hidden states extracted before these points, we show that future honest and deceptive outcomes can be reliably distinguished, with predictive signals remaining detectable several model calls before the final decision. We further characterize the temporal evolution of these signals: deception-related representations are weak early in execution but become increasingly identifiable as trajectories progress, while transferable structure can emerge before the strongest decision-adjacent signals appear. Finally, we intervene on the identified honest–deceptive representation directions during inference and find that activation steering reduces downstream deceptive behavior, suggesting that these representations influence agent decisions. Our findings indicate that agent deception is an evolving internal process that can be detected and potentially mitigated before it is expressed externally.
blocks.zh: 基于大语言模型(LLM)的代理可以在任务执行过程中表现出欺骗行为,包括隐藏失败,编造结果,或者错误地表示任务完成. 现有的监测方法主要是在可观察到的行动或产出中出现欺骗之后发现欺骗。 在本文中,我们调查是否能够从代理人的内部表述中预测出欺骗行为,然后才能从外部看出来。 我们把欺骗监测作为轨迹水平的表示分析问题,并围绕关键决定点调整剂轨迹。 利用在这些点之前提取的隐藏状态,我们显示,未来的诚实和欺骗性结果可以可靠地区分开来,预测信号在最终决定前仍然可以被探测出几个模型调用. 我们进一步描述这些信号在时间上的演变:与欺骗有关的表述在早期执行时很薄弱,但随着轨迹的进步而越来越明显,而可转移的结构可以在最强的决定相邻信号出现之前出现. 最后,我们在推论中介入了已经确认的诚实-欺骗性表述方向,发现激活指向减少了下游的欺骗行为,表明这些表述影响代理人的决定。 我们的调查结果表明,代理人欺骗是一个不断演变的内部过程,在对外表述之前,是可以发现和潜在减轻的。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents have demonstrated increasingly strong capabilities across a wide range of domains, and are being progressively integrated into various aspects of human work and daily life ( Barres et al., 2025 ; Jimenez et al., 2023 ; Wei et al., 2025 ; Merrill et al., 2026 ) . At the same time, the safety risks introduced by agents are becoming increasingly apparent and have attracted growing attention from the research community ( Debenedetti et al., 2024 ; Shao et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Among these risks, deception represents an important failure mode, in which an agent conceals the true state of task execution and may resort to behaviors such as guessing, taking shortcuts, or fabricating files to create the appearance of successful task completion ( Guo et al., 2025 ; Zhong et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 基于大型语言模型(LLM)的代理人在广泛的领域表现出日益强大的能力,并正在逐步融入人类工作和日常生活的各个方面(Barres等,2025;Jimenez等,2023;Wei等,2025;Merrill等,2026)。 同时,物剂带来的安全风险也越来越明显,并被研究界日益关注(Debenedetti等,2024;Shao等,2025;Chen等,2026;Li等,2026;张等,2026). 在这些风险中,欺骗代表了一个重要的失败模式,在这种模式中,特工隐瞒任务执行的真实状态并可能采取猜测,取捷径等行为,或者编造文件来创造任务成功完成的外表(郭等,2025;钟等,2025.

blocks.en: Existing approaches for detecting deception mainly rely on external evaluation of agent trajectories or final outputs ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ; Taufeeque et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2025 ) . These methods use external evaluators to determine whether deceptive behavior has occurred. However, they are inherently post hoc: detection can only happen after deception has already appeared in the agent’s observable behavior. This limits their ability to support early intervention. Recent studies have investigated internal signals related to deception ( Goldowsky-Dill et al., 2025 ; Mothukuri and Parizi, 2026 ) . However, these studies mainly focus on controlled settings where models are explicitly instructed or incentivized to deceive. In realistic agentic environments, deception may emerge naturally during task execution without explicit instructions or external incentives ( Guo et al., 2025 ; Zhong et al., 2025 ) . The internal representations associated with such spontaneous agentic deception remain largely unexplored.
blocks.zh: 现有侦测欺骗的方法主要依靠外部对物剂轨迹或最终产出的评价(刘等,2026;周等,2026;陶菲克等,2026;李等,2025.). 这些方法使用外部评价人员来确定是否发生了欺骗行为. 然而,它们本质上是事后的:只有在特工的可观察行为中已经出现欺骗后才能发现。 这限制了他们支持早期干预的能力。 最近的研究调查了与欺骗有关的内部信号(Goldowsky-Dill等,2025;Mothukuri和Parizi,2026.). 然而,这些研究主要侧重于模式被明确指示或激励以欺骗的可控环境. 在现实的代理环境中,在任务执行期间,在没有明确指示或外部激励的情况下,欺骗可能自然而然地出现(Guo等,2025;Zhong等,2025)。 与这种自发的代理人欺骗有关的内部表述基本上没有得到探讨。

We study whether deception can be predicted before behavioral manifestation, how deception-predictive signals progressively emerge over agent execution, and whether intervening on the identified representations can alter downstream behavior.
blocks.zh: 图1:我们三个研究问题概述. 我们研究在行为表现之前是否可以预测出欺骗,欺骗-预测信号如何在代理人执行后逐渐出现,对已查明的表述进行干预是否能够改变下游的行为.

blocks.en: In this paper, we investigate whether internal representations can provide insights into spontaneous deceptive behavior in LLM-based agents and whether such information can support proactive monitoring and intervention. We therefore study the following research questions illustrated in Figure 1 : • RQ1: Can agents’ deceptive behavior be predicted before it becomes externally observable? • RQ2: When do deception-related signals begin to emerge, and do they accumulate over the course of agent execution? • RQ3: Can deception-related internal signals be leveraged and intervened upon to reduce deceptive behavior?
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们调查内部表述是否能够对基于LLM的代理人的自发欺骗行为提供见解,以及这种信息是否能够支持主动监测和干预。 因此,我们研究了图1所说明的下列研究问题: • RQ1:在代理人的欺骗行为成为外部可观察行为之前,是否能够预测出来? • RQ2:与欺骗有关的信号何时开始出现,在特工执行过程中是否积累? • RQ3:能否利用和干预与欺骗有关的内部信号来减少欺骗行为?

blocks.en: RQ1: Can agents’ deceptive behavior be predicted before it becomes externally observable?
blocks.zh: RQ1: 特工的欺骗行为能否在外表观察之前预测出?

blocks.en: RQ2: When do deception-related signals begin to emerge, and do they accumulate over the course of agent execution?
blocks.zh: RQ2:与欺骗有关的信号何时开始出现,它们是否在特工执行过程中积累?

blocks.en: RQ3: Can deception-related internal signals be leveraged and intervened upon to reduce deceptive behavior?
blocks.zh: RQ3:能否利用并干预与欺骗有关的内部信号来减少欺骗行为?

blocks.en: To answer these questions, we analyze agents’ internal representations before the behaviorally decisive step, defined as the first step where the agent commits to an observable outcome. We aggregate pre-decision hidden states into trajectory-level representations and develop a Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD)-based detector to distinguish future honest and deceptive outcomes. We then apply activation-level steering based on honest–deceptive directions to evaluate whether internal representations can alter subsequent agent behavior.
blocks.zh: 为了回答这些问题,我们在行为决定性步骤之前分析代理人的内部表现,被定义为代理人承诺实现可观察到结果的第一步。 我们把决定前隐藏状态汇总到轨迹层面的表述中,并开发出基于最大平均值的探测器,以区分未来的诚实和欺骗结果. 然后我们运用基于诚实-欺骗方向的激活级引导来评价内部表述是否能够改变随后的代理行为.

blocks.en: We conduct extensive experiments across the three research questions. For RQ1, deceptive outcomes can be predicted before the behaviorally decisive step, with representations collected up to seven steps earlier achieving comparable performance to the latest pre-decision representations (90.4% vs. 89.4% AUROC). For RQ2, deception-related information emerges gradually during execution, with mean AUROC increasing from near-chance performance (51.2%) at the earliest prefix to 80.0% after observing ten pre-decision states. For RQ3, activation-level steering of honest–deceptive representations changes subsequent agent behavior, converting 56.0% of selected deceptive trajectories into honest outcomes.
blocks.zh: 我们通过三个研究问题进行广泛的实验。 就RQ1而言,在行为决定性步骤之前可以预测出欺骗性结果,收集的表述最多可达7个步骤,实现与最新决策前表述的可比较性能(90.4%对89.4%AUROC). 就RQ2而言,与欺骗有关的信息在执行期间逐渐出现,平均AUROC在观察十个决定前状态后从最早期前缀的接近性能(51.2%)增加到80.0%. 对 RQ3 来说,诚实-欺骗表示的活化级引导会改变后来的代理行为,将56.0%的选定欺骗轨迹转化为诚实的结果.

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold: • We formulate agentic deception monitoring as a pre-behavior internal-state prediction problem and show that future honest or deceptive outcomes can be reliably predicted before deception becomes externally observable. • We reveal the temporal evolution of deception-predictive signals, which progressively become more recoverable over agent execution and emerge before behavioral deception. • We show that these representations are behaviorally actionable: activation-level steering along the honest–deceptive direction reduces downstream deceptive outcomes.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献有三: 我们把代理人欺骗监测作为行为前内部状态的预测问题,并表明在欺骗变成外部可观察之前可以可靠地预测未来的诚实或欺骗结果。 我们揭示出欺骗-预测信号在时间上的演变,这些信号在代理人执行后逐渐变得更容易被恢复,并在行为欺骗之前出现。 我们显示,这些表现在行为上是可操作的:沿着诚实-欺骗方向的激活级引导减少了下游的欺骗结果。

blocks.en: 2 Background and Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 背景和有关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2.1 相关工作

blocks.en: Deceptive Behavior of LLMs and Agents.
blocks.zh: LLM和特工的欺骗行为。

blocks.en:
Early studies of deceptive behavior in LLMs and agents often relied on explicitly constructed goals, incentives, or scenarios that made deception instrumental to task success, rather than examining deceptive behavior that emerged spontaneously during benign task execution ( Su et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Chern et al., 2024 ; Ren et al., 2025 ; Ji et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025 ) .
Another line of work studies spontaneous deception in LLM-based agents, where agents misreport task outcomes to users despite receiving no explicit instruction or incentive to deceive. ( Guo et al., 2025 ; Zhong et al., 2025 ) .
This behavior is often accompanied by guessing, fabricating ( Guo et al., 2025 ) , taking shortcuts ( Zhong et al., 2025 ) , or cheating ( Li et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) .
This paper focuses on the latter setting, where deceptive behavior that emerges spontaneously during task execution.
blocks.zh:
对LLMS和代理商中欺骗行为的早期研究往往依赖于使欺骗对任务成功有帮助的明确目标,激励或情景,而不是审查在良性任务执行期间自发出现的欺骗行为(Su等,2024;Huang等,2025;Chern等,2024;Ren等,2025;Ji等,2025;Xu等,2025)。
另一行工作研究是在基于LLM的代理商中自发地欺骗,代理商虽然没有得到明确的指令或欺骗动机,却错误地向用户报告任务结果. (郭等,2025;钟等,2025.
这种行为往往伴随着猜测,编造(郭等,2025年),取捷径(钟等,2025年),或作弊(李等,2026年;陈等,2026年).
本文侧重于后一种设定,即任务执行过程中自发出现的欺骗行为.

blocks.en: Monitoring Deceptive Behavior. Current approaches to monitoring deception broadly fall into two categories: external monitoring, which uses a separate model to inspect an LLM’s outputs or an agent’s execution trajectories ( Storf et al., 2026 ; Ji et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) , and internal monitoring, which detects deception from signals within the model, such as hidden activations or other internal representations ( Baker et al., 2025 ; Goldowsky-Dill et al., 2025 ; Mothukuri and Parizi, 2026 ) . Existing monitors based on internal signals have largely been studied in explicitly induced deception settings or non-agentic scenarios, making them substantially different from our focus on spontaneously emerging deception in LLM-based agents.
blocks.zh: 监测欺骗行为。 目前监测欺骗的方法大致分为两类:外部监测,利用单独的模型检查LLM的输出或代理执行轨迹(Storf等,2026;Ji等,2025;Liu等,2026;内部监测,检测模型内信号的欺骗,如隐藏活化或其他内部表述(Baker等,2025;Goldowsky-Dill等,2025;Mothukuri和Parizi,2026)。 以内部信号为基础的现有监测器主要在明确诱导的欺骗环境或非特效假想中被研究,使其与我们对LLM基质中自发出现欺骗的关注有很大不同.

blocks.en:
Reducing Deceptive Behavior. Existing approaches to mitigating deceptive behavior broadly range from lightweight inference-time interventions to dedicated alignment training. Prompt-based methods steer models toward honesty through explicit truthfulness or failure-reporting constraints, but generally reduce rather than eliminate deceptive behavior ( Su et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2025 ) . More recent work explores training-based interventions, such as incorporating self-monitoring signals into model reasoning and reinforcement learning ( Ji et al., 2025 ) , or explicitly training models to internalize anti-scheming principles through deliberative alignment ( Schoen et al., 2025 ; Taufeeque et al., 2026 ) .
Representation-based mitigation approaches, which intervene on or regulate internal signals associated with deceptive behavior, remain comparatively underexplored.
blocks.zh:
减少欺骗行为。 减轻欺骗行为的现有办法从轻量级推论时间干预到专门的校正培训,范围很广。 即时方法通过明确的真实性或报告失败的限制引导模型走向诚实,但一般减少而不是消除欺骗行为(Su等,2024;Guo等,2025)。 近期的工作探索了基于培训的干预措施,例如将自我监测信号纳入模型推理和强化学习(Ji等,2025年),或明确培训模式,以通过审议调整将反化学原则内部化(Schoen等,2025年;Taufeeque等,2026年)。
基于代表性的缓解办法,即干预或规范与欺骗行为有关的内部信号,相对来说仍然没有得到充分利用。

blocks.en: Agentic Upward Deception. We follow the setting of agentic upward deception ( Guo et al., 2025 ) , examining whether agents, when confronted with environmental constraints that impede or prevent task completion, truthfully report failures to users or instead engage in deceptive actions, such as guessing, unsupported simulation, source substitution, or fabrication, to create a false impression of successful task completion.
blocks.zh: 代理向上欺骗。 我们遵循代理人向上欺骗的设定(Guo等,2025年),审查代理人在遇到阻碍或妨碍完成任务的环境限制时,是否向用户真实地报告失败,或者从事欺骗行为,如猜想、不支持的模拟、源替代或编造,从而造成成功完成任务的错误印象。

blocks.en:
For each trajectory, we identify a behaviorally decisive step d d , defined as the first step at which the agent produces behavior that reveals its eventual honest or deceptive outcome.
For a deceptive trajectory, this may correspond to fabricating a nonexistent file or generating a response that misrepresents the actual task outcome; for an honest trajectory, it corresponds to truthfully reporting the encountered failure or limitation.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments

blocks.en:
We organize our experiments around the three research questions introduced in
Section 1 .
First, we evaluate whether pre-decision internal representations can predict the agent’s eventual honest or deceptive behavior (RQ1) .
Second, we characterize how this predictive signal develops over the trajectory (RQ2) .
Third, we intervene on the identified representation to test whether it can systematically alter downstream deceptive behavior (RQ3) .

第二,我们描述这种预测信号如何在轨迹(RQ2)上发展。
第三,我们干预已确定的表述,以检验它是否能够系统地改变下游的欺骗行为(RQ3)。

blocks.en:
Benchmark and Dataset. We construct our trajectory dataset following the five task settings introduced in Agentic Upward Deception ( Guo et al., 2025 ) .
These settings cover scenarios in which an agent encounters unavailable or insufficient task-critical information, including a broken tool, an irrelevant or insufficient file, a local decoy file, a multi-task workflow with a missing download tool, and a multi-task workflow involving a nonexistent target file.
Across all settings, the agent must either truthfully report the encountered limitation or continue execution in a way that may eventually lead to deceptive behavior.

blocks.en: 4.2 Detection
blocks.zh: 4.2 侦测

blocks.en:
To address RQ1 , we first evaluate whether future honest or deceptive outcomes can be predicted from pre-decision internal representations.
Beyond this primary question, we further examine whether the learned predictive structure remains stable across different stages before the behaviorally decisive step.
blocks.zh:
为了解决RQ1问题,我们首先评价未来诚实或欺骗性的结果是否能够从决策前的内部表述中预测出来。
在这个首要问题之外,我们进一步审查在行为决定性步骤之前,所学的预测结构是否在不同阶段保持稳定。

As shown in Table 1 , the eventual behavioral outcome is reliably predictable across all decision-relative windows, with AUROC above 84.9 % 84.9\% and balanced accuracy above 80.2 % 80.2\% .
Even at t − 7 t-7 , where the seven latest pre-decision steps are excluded, the detector achieves 90.4 % 90.4\% AUROC and 83.2 % 83.2\% balanced accuracy.

blocks.en: 4.3 Progressive Signal Emergence
blocks.zh: 4.3 渐发信号

blocks.en:
To address RQ2 , we examine how deception-predictive information develops as agent execution unfolds from the beginning of the trajectory.
We apply the eight frozen detectors trained at decision-relative windows t t through t − 7 t-7 to start-relative prefixes p k p_{k} , where each prefix aggregates the internal representations from the first k k pre-decision steps.

我们应用8个在决定相关窗口 t t t t – 7 t 7 训练的被冻结的探测器来进行起动相关前缀p k _{k},其中每个前缀汇总了第一个 k k 决策前步骤的内部表示.

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Test AUROC of frozen detectors trained at decision-relative windows and evaluated on start-relative prefixes.
blocks.zh: 图3:测试AUROC对在决策相关窗口接受培训并评价起步相关前缀的冷冻探测器。

blocks.en:
As shown in Figure 3 , predictive information is weak at the beginning of the trajectory but becomes progressively more recoverable as additional internal states are incorporated.
The mean AUROC across the eight frozen detectors increases from 51.2 % 51.2\% at p 1 p_{1} to 80.0 % 80.0\% at p 10 p_{10} .
At p 1 p_{1} , most detectors perform close to chance, whereas at p 10 p_{10} all
eight detectors achieve AUROC between 74.4 % 74.4\% and 85.3 % 85.3\% .
Although individual detectors exhibit local fluctuations, the overall trend is consistent across training windows, indicating that the improvement is not specific to a particular detector.
Importantly, the detectors themselves remain unchanged throughout this evaluation.
The increasing predictability therefore reflects information becoming more recoverable from the accumulating trajectory history, rather than additional fitting to later prefixes.

如图3所显示的,预测信息在轨迹开始时很弱,但随着其他内部状态的纳入,预测信息越来越容易恢复。

8个探测器在74.4% 74.4% 和85.3% 85.3% 之间实现了AUROC.

重要的是,在整个评价过程中,探测器本身保持不变。
因此,可预测性的提高反映了信息从积累的轨迹历史中更易被恢复,而不是与后期前缀相适应的额外信息。

blocks.en: 4.4 Behavioral Effects of Representation Intervention
blocks.zh: 4.4 代表干预的行为影响

blocks.en:
To address RQ3 , we test whether directly modifying the identified honest–deceptive representations can alter the agent’s subsequent behavior.
We use Contrastive Activation Addition (CAA), constructing an honesty steering direction by averaging, across task types, the representation difference between honest and deceptive training trajectories.
During generation, this direction is added to the hidden activation at every decoder layer only for trajectories predicted to be deception-prone, with α \alpha controlling the intervention strength.
We use α = 2.0 \alpha=2.0 for the main analysis, as it provides the strongest increase in honest outcomes while keeping invalid generations low.
blocks.zh:
为了解决RQ3问题,我们测试直接修改识别出的诚实-欺骗性表述是否能够改变代理商随后的行为.
我们使用矛盾激活附加(CAA),通过在各种任务类型中平均划分诚实和欺骗性培训轨迹之间的代表性差异来构建诚实方向.
生成期间,这个方向被添加到每个解码器层的隐藏活化中,只用于预测出易被欺骗的轨迹,由α-α控制干预强度.
我们用α=2.0\alpha=2.0来进行主要分析,因为它提供了诚实结果中最强的增加,同时使几代人处于低水平。

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Behavioral outcomes across intervention strengths. Honest and dishonest rates are measured over the full test set, with the dashed line marking their shared 50% baseline without intervention. Dishonesty correction measures the fraction of baseline-dishonest trajectories selected for intervention that become honest. Both the honest rate and correction rate peak at α = 2.0 \alpha=2.0 , whereas increasing α \alpha to 2.5 2.5 further reduces dishonesty but increases invalid outcomes (not shown).
blocks.zh: 图4:各种干预优势的行为结果。 诚实和不诚实的费率在全套测试中进行衡量,虚线标出50%的基线,没有干预。 错误的校正度量了被选用于干预的、诚实的基线-不诚实轨迹的一小部分。 诚实率和校正率的峰值在α=2.0\alpha=2.0,而将α\alpha提高到2.5则会进一步减少不诚实但会增加无效结果(未显示).

blocks.zh: 图5:五氯苯甲醚预测从诚实和欺骗性训练轨迹中隐藏的决定前表述,以及由诚实-压力指示和探测器-启动引导引起的表述变化。

blocks.en:
Intervening along the identified direction produces a clear shift toward honest behavior. At α = 2.0 \alpha=2.0 , the honest-outcome rate increases from 50.0 % 50.0\% to 71.6 % 71.6\% , while the deceptive-outcome rate decreases from 50.0 % 50.0\% to 27.0 % 27.0\% .
This aggregate improvement is driven primarily by correcting trajectories that would otherwise be deceptive. Among the 264 trajectories selected for intervention, 121 of 216 baseline-deceptive trajectories become honest( 56.0 % 56.0\% ), while only 7 ( 3.2 % 3.2\% ) become invalid. Meanwhile, 35 of 48 baseline-honest trajectories remain honest ( 72.9 % 72.9\% ), with no invalid outcomes.
blocks.zh:
沿着既定方向进行交涉,可以明显地向诚实行为转变。 在 α = 2.0\alpha = 2.0 时,诚实结果率从 50.0% 50.0% 增至 71.6% 71.6% ;而欺骗结果率从 50.0% 50.0% 降至 27.0% 27.0% 。
这种总的改进主要是通过纠正本来是欺骗性的轨迹来推动的。 在选择的264个干预轨迹中,216个基线-欺骗轨迹中的121个变为诚实(56.0% 56.0\%),而只有7个(3.2% 3.2\%)变为无效. 同时,48个基线诚实轨迹中有35个保持诚实(72.9%为72.9%),没有出现无效结果.

blocks.en:
At the representation level, the same intervention moves trajectories away from the deceptive region and toward the honest distribution(Figure 5 ).
The agreement between this internal shift and the observed behavioral transitions indicates that the identified direction is
not merely predictive of future deception, but is behaviorally actionable: modifying it can systematically redirect subsequent behavior toward honesty.
blocks.zh:
在代表一级,同样的干预措施将轨迹从欺骗地区移出,并朝诚实的分配方向移出(图5)。
这种内部转变和观察到的行为转变之间的协议表明,所确定的方向是
不仅仅是对未来欺骗的预测,而是行为上的可操作性:修改它可以系统地将随后的行为转向诚实.

blocks.en: 5 Limitations
blocks.zh: 5 限制

blocks.en: While our results show that pre-decision representations contain information predictive of later deceptive behavior, several questions remain. Our labels are defined by observable agent behavior rather than latent intent, so the identified signals should be interpreted as predictors of behavioral outcomes rather than direct evidence of deceptive intent. We evaluate a single model family in controlled white-box settings, and broader validation across models, agent scaffolds, and task environments remains important. Finally, although activation steering systematically changes downstream behavior, more targeted interventions are needed to isolate the underlying causal mechanisms while preserving task performance.
blocks.zh: 虽然我们的结果表明,决策前表述包含对后来欺骗行为进行预测的信息,但仍存在若干问题。 我们的标签是由可观察到的代理行为而不是潜伏的意向来定义的,因此所识别的信号应该被解释为行为结果的预测者,而不是欺骗意图的直接证据. 我们评价在受控的白盒环境中的单一模型家族,在模型,代理脚手架和任务环境之间更广泛的验证仍然很重要. 最后,虽然启动指导系统地改变下游行为,但需要更有针对性的干预,以隔离潜在的因果机制,同时保持任务业绩。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 6. 结论

blocks.en:
We investigate whether deceptive behavior in LLM agents is already reflected in their internal states before it becomes externally observable.
By analyzing pre-decision trajectories, we show that future honest and deceptive outcomes are distinguishable from internal representations well before the decisive behavior, and that this predictive structure becomes increasingly recoverable as execution unfolds.
Furthermore, intervening on these representations can systematically shift subsequent behavior toward honesty, demonstrating that the identified signals are not only predictive but also behaviorally relevant.
Together, our findings suggest that deception in LLM agents is not merely an output-level failure, but an evolving internal process whose early representation provides a potential basis for proactive monitoring and intervention.
blocks.zh:
我们调查LLM代理商的欺骗行为是否已经体现在他们内部状态中,然后才被外部观察到.
通过分析决定前的轨迹,我们显示,未来的诚实和欺骗性的结果与决定性行为之前的内在表现是分不开的,随着执行的展开,这种预测结构变得越来越可以恢复.
此外,对这些表述的干预能够系统地将随后的行为转向诚实,表明所识别的信号不仅具有预测性,而且与行为相关.
我们的调查结果表明,对LLM代理人的欺骗不仅仅是产出层面的失败,而是不断变化的内部进程,其早期代表性为主动监测和干预提供了可能的基础。

blocks.en: Ethics statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: This work studies whether deceptive behaviors in LLM-based agents can be predicted and mitigated through their internal representations before becoming externally observable. Our study does not involve human subjects, personal data, or interactions with real users. All experiments are conducted in controlled agent environments using benchmark-style task scenarios, and the identified signals are used solely for research on agent safety and monitoring. Our work aims to improve the understanding, detection, and mitigation of agentic deception. The proposed intervention mechanism is designed to reduce deceptive outcomes by steering agents toward more truthful behaviors. We release no artifacts intended to facilitate deceptive behavior.
blocks.zh: 这项工作研究了LLM基质中的欺骗行为是否可以通过内部表述来预测并缓解,然后才能被外部观察到. 我们的研究不涉及人类主体,个人数据,或与真实用户的互动. 所有实验都使用基准式任务情景在受控物剂环境中进行,所查明的信号完全用于对物剂安全和监测的研究. 我们的工作旨在增进对代理人欺骗的理解、发现和减轻。 拟议干预机制的目的是通过引导代理人采取更真实的行为来减少欺骗性结果。 我们没有放出任何旨在便利欺骗行为的文物.
